name: Sticky Notes
description: Lightweight sticky notes on your desktop, with Markdown (headings, bold/italic, lists, checkboxes, code, quotes, links). Left-click the panel icon to show or hide notes (creates one if none exist); right-click for New Note, Restore Closed, Tile, Cascade, Gather, Restore Layout, Focus On Edit, Live Markdown, Snap Notes and Preferences. Drag by the top bar, resize from the bottom-right corner. Super+Alt+N new note, Super+Alt+H show/hide. Notes are saved to ~/.local/share/sticky-notes/notes.json, or to a folder of your choice in Preferences (for example one kept in sync between computers by Syncthing or Nextcloud).
